title: Answer: mind emerges when a self-organizing system must monitor itself, feeling when needs must be ranked

statements.text: Minds emerge from the imperative of self-organizing systems to monitor their own states against dissipative forces, at first as proto-mental value. Feeling emerges later, in a graded transition, when many needs must be told apart and prioritized in novel contexts. Perceptual and cognitive consciousness emerge from affective consciousness.

sources.quote: We have seen that minds emerge in consequence of the existential imperative of self-organizing systems to monitor their own internal states
suggest a graded transition from proto-mental to mental states
